description: Our Power BI visual, Calendar Heatmap, displays your data as a color-coded calendar, making it easy to spot trends, activity peaks, and anomalies at a glance. It is particularly well suited for tracking temporal changes across many domains, such as finance, manufacturing, logistics, or web monitoring. DISPLAY MODES Continuous: Classic horizontal view across the full year Month by month: Separate blocks for each month Calendar: Traditional calendar layout with weeks and days Hour by hour (0-24h): View data by hour of the day EXPECTED FIELDS Date: Date field used to define the time period Categories (optional): To display multiple heatmaps across different dimensions Values: Measure rendered as color intensity Tooltips: Additional measures displayed on hover VISUAL CUSTOMIZATION Customizable color gradient for minimum, maximum, and median values Customizable thresholds for these values Cell spacing and corner radius Configurable axis labels (years, months, weeks, days, hours) Customizable text color and typography Native Power BI tooltips or custom tooltip styling ANALYTICAL PURPOSE Identify time-based trends in your data day by day Spot anomalies using color intensity Compare trends across categories in multi-heatmap mode Visualize high-frequency data in a readable way LEARN MORE Website: https://www.actinvision.com/ Contact us: Contact form
